# Tiny Steps Learning

> Tiny Steps Learning is a premium online English learning school for children ages 3-12, offering live phonics, reading, grammar, and public speaking classes with assessment-first placement and parent-visible progress.

Tiny Steps Learning supports children through structured English foundation programs, including 1:1 online phonics classes, reading fluency support, grammar learning, public speaking, digital practice, and parent updates. Tiny Steps has served 5000+ students across 15+ countries. Current reference pricing is Rs. 400 per class and Rs. 4,800 for 12 classes.
